# Tide keeping

## The morning table

The keeper on duty writes the tide table at six every morning. The table is
copied from the almanac into the brass-bound ledger and then pinned beside the
lamp room door.

## Where things live

The almanac lives in the brass cabinet beside the lamp. Marta Quill holds the
only spare key to the cabinet, and she hangs it on the hook behind the kitchen
clock. The ledger stays on the desk in the watch room.

## Corrections

If the almanac and the harbour board disagree by more than ten minutes, the
keeper rings the harbour office before the next high water and writes "checked
by telephone" in the margin. A correction is never made by scratching out the
printed figure.
